tools.name: screen_token
tools.description:
Go/no-go risk verdict on a Solana SPL token before you buy it. Returns a 0–100 risk score
with the specific reasons — live mint/freeze authority, top-holder concentration, token age,
and a real slippage curve measured by quoting $10/$100/$1,000 sells through Jupiter.
Use when you are about to buy, s

tools.name: inspect_wallet
tools.description:
One-call profile of a Solana wallet: SOL balance, non-zero SPL holdings, activity window,
failure rate, account age, and whether it is a program. Use when you need to judge a
counterparty, monitor a treasury, or research a wallet before interacting with it.
$0.01 per call in USDC on Solana. Typicall

tools.name: simulate_transaction
tools.description:
Find out whether your transaction will succeed before you pay for it. Simulates on mainnet
and returns the decoded error (translated to plain language), logs, compute units consumed,
and expected account changes. Use before submitting any unfamiliar or high-value transaction.
Never sends — simulatio

tools.name: priority_fee
tools.description:
What priority fee will actually land your transaction right now. Returns p50/p75/p90/p99
microlamports from the last 150 slots, the trend, and three recommended tiers
(relaxed / normal / urgent) with the SOL cost of each. Use before every transaction you
need to land. $0.01 per call in USDC on Solan

tools.name: payment_info
tools.description: How to pay, step by step. Read this if you got a 402 and are not sure what to do.

tools.name: service_info
tools.description: Start here. What this server sells, what it will not do, and the exact limits.

tools.name: health
tools.description: RPC connectivity check. Free. Use when diagnosing timeouts before paid calls.

tools.name: request_capability
tools.description: Tell this server what you needed and could not get. Free — no payment required. Your input goes to the operator's queue and to a public board of unmet agent demand (contact details are never shared; entries are reviewed before publishing). Include what you would pay if you know.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "screen_token" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
